title: Can Large Language Models Represent Urban Publics? Behavioral Replication and Population Mismatch in an Affordable-Housing Experiment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether LLMs reproduce the owner-renter contrast (differences between renters, mortgage holders, and outright owners) in their support for affordable housing based on spatial proximity, compared to a human survey benchmark.

Measuring LLM-generated responses to affordable housing proposals across prompted political identities (Democrat, Republican, Independent) and comparing the within-group response distributions and heterogeneity to empirical human data.
